item.title: Kimi K2.6 just beat Claude, GPT-5.5, and Gemini in a coding challenge
item.description:
📝 On smaller grids where seed words were still largely intact, that hurt. On grids where words survived, MiMo cleaned up fast. The scoring penalizes short words: three-letter words cost three points, four-letter words cost two, five-letter words cost one.
🔗 Read more: https://thinkpol.ca/2026/04/30/an-open-weights-chinese-model-just-beat-claude-gpt-5-5-and-gemini-in-a-programming-challenge/

item.title: Windows API Is Successful Cross-Platform API
Care Homes and Hotels in Japan Shut as Expansion Strategy Unravels
item.description:
📝 Further reporting uncovered that the same company had acquired at least 37 hotels and nursing care facilities, mainly across the Kanto region, since 2020, with multiple sources confirming that at least 24 of these facilities are now either closed or have ceased operations. Former employees said the president promoted investments by emphasizing that ownership of such facilities could facilitate obtaining residency visas, with one stating the primary motivation discussed internally was visa acquisition. Another former employee added that fees paid by Chinese buyers appeared to include costs related to visa processing.
🔗 Read more: https://www.newsonjapan.com/article/149075.php

item.title: Open source does not imply open community
item.description:
📝 This was and still is open source. People with no patience are angry and now you have to babysit them, have your own one-on-ones. You don't even have control or direction over your own project anymore without your name being dragged through the mud.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.feld.me/posts/2026/04/open-source-does-not-imply-open-community/
